author: (de Saussure, 1857)

note.en: A small swimming crab of shallow sand and shell bottoms, known here from one 1971 museum specimen from Costa Rica's Caribbean coast, with no record of anyone meeting it.
note.es: Una jaiba pequeña de fondos de arena y conchuela poco profundos, conocida aquí por un solo ejemplar de museo de 1971 de la costa caribeña de Costa Rica, sin registros de que alguien la haya visto.

evidence: GBIF: UM-RSMAS museum specimen (1971), Caribbean Costa Rica

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro
Williams 1984, Marine Decapod Crustaceans of the Carolinas (sizes as cited in a Brazilian Portunidae study, Nauplius)
